name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Operations | Attribution & Tracking, Lifecycle Automation & AI Agents
summary: Marketing operations builder who works as a team of one and builds the system from scratch. I design tracking at build time (GA4 conversion events, custom GTM triggers, enforced UTM conventions), lifecycle stages, scoring, and triggered journeys in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, and I build AI agents and automations that replace manual work: workflows that call the OpenAI and Claude APIs in n8n, Make, and Zapier to score prospects and generate personalized outreach. A decade on the B2B sales side means I build for pipeline, not just activity.

experience.title: Marketing Operations Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead

Built a 20+ workflow lifecycle system with triggered email and SMS journeys from capture through onboarding, reactivation, and review requests, holding deliverability above 99%.
Define lifecycle stages and lead scoring, set up marketing-to-CRM syncs and data feeds into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, and build evaluation loops that monitor agent output quality.
Build pipeline and funnel dashboards in Power BI and SQL, delivering recommendations to leadership.
